feedback:
Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. It is the iteration 6 controller (kp 1.5, ki 0.02, kd 0.6, base_speed 1.2, line_loss last_direction, sensor_weights -2 to 2) with one geometry change: all five sensors moved forward from y 0.04 to y 0.06. Every field is within the contract ranges, and the candidate is identical to the best raced design (iteration 6, score 604.0) apart from sensor y, so any result is attributable to that change. Iteration 7 showed that changing line_loss to search_right left every metric and the score unchanged, so the lost-line rule is not the lever for slalom. Across iterations 4 to 6, slalom line_loss_events stayed at 1.0 and progress at about 0.24 to 0.33 under kp 1.7 and 1.5 and kd 0.5 and 0.6, so gain changes have not fixed it either. Moving the sensors forward is a reasonable test of whether the robot reacts too late to slalom direction changes. The main risk is that the longer lead adds steering oscillation: s-bend was 0.397 and oval 0.356 in iteration 6, both close to the 0.4 guard. The candidate is a valid, single-variable test of the best design, and it is worth racing because the downside is limited and the telemetry will show whether geometry is the slalom lever.

Read the next race as follows. If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 or slalom progress rises above 0.33, and oval finishes stay near 18 of 20, keep sensor y 0.06 and test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change. If s-bend or oval steering_oscillation exceeds 0.4 without a fall in slalom line_loss_events, revert sensor y to 0.04 and keep the iteration 6 controller. If slalom line_loss_events stay at 1.0 under the forward shift, geometry is not the slalom fix either, so test base_speed 1.0 on the iteration 6 design, since the robot may be leaving the track at speed on the tight bends.
requested_changes: If slalom line_loss_events fall below 1.0 or slalom progress rises above 0.33 with oval finishes near 18 of 20, keep all five sensors at y 0.06 and test controller.base_speed 1.4 as the next single change, because iteration 6 shows speed is the next limit once line loss is controlled.

If s-bend or oval steering_oscillation exceeds 0.4 (iteration 6 s-bend was 0.397) without a fall in slalom line_loss_events, revert geometry.sensor_positions y to 0.04 and keep the iteration 6 controller with line_loss last_direction.

If slalom line_loss_events stay at 1.0 with sensors at y 0.06, do not change kp, kd or line_loss again (iterations 4 to 7 show no response); test controller.base_speed 1.0 on the iteration 6 design to check whether speed causes the off-track exits on the tight bends.
